paragraphs_zh: 北海岸的海女，世代以身體與潮汐對話。她們不靠儀器，只靠經驗與呼吸，判斷何時下水、何處採集。
「拾間」記錄的不只是採集的技藝，更是一種與海洋共處的節奏——在潮起潮落之間，找到工作、生活與傳承的縫隙。
paragraphs_en: Generations of sea-women along Taiwan's north coast have read the tide with their bodies, relying on experience and breath rather than instruments to decide when to dive and where to gather.
ShiJian documents not only a gathering practice, but a rhythm of living alongside the sea — finding room for work, life, and continuity between the rise and fall of the tide.
